name: UniFi Protect
description: Native adoption in UniFi Protect over ONVIF: 20 fps with the sensor at the same rate (no frame-skip judder), 2 s keyframes, VBR 2.5 Mbps main / 400 kbps sub (Protect pulls the sub stream twice), AAC audio (Protect ignores G711), no RTCP sender reports, camera motion events for Protect without the extra VideoSource/MotionAlarm topic (Protect merges topics and the state flaps), deeper send queue and Wi-Fi video priority, PTZ only on cameras with motors.
